text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You're shaken, Trainer. Even through the 
monitor, it's plain as day."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You've realized it, haven't you—that 
you're already in checkmate!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You walked right into my trap. And 
with that, it's game, set, match!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we move on to the next 
match? There are a few other games I'd 
like to try. We still have plenty of time, 
so let's enjoy ourselves.

Rulership spent her day off immersed in 
video games, and seems fully refreshed in 
both mind and body!
